decisions.reason: The premium visual-positioning goal does not replace or modify the existing beige and green color specifications.
The source expresses a broad aesthetic goal and future brainstorming intent but does not change any branding text, logo, font, or placard requirement.
The visual-positioning change does not alter the selected bowl capacity, depth, or form, and the client explicitly intends to keep the engineering intact.
The source does not change splash-control behavior or mitigation requirements and states that visual elevation should preserve the engineering.
No spout geometry, orientation, construction, or beverage-quality constraint is changed by the premium visual-positioning decision.
The source does not modify the whisk selection, dimensions, attachment, or operating position.
The broad visual goal does not change the platform configuration, height, cup clearance, or mixer fit.
The source does not alter bowl removal, swapping, cleaning access, or event-use behavior.
Prioritizing proof of the mixing process does not change the required smooth, frothy mixing result or high-speed behavior.
The source reinforces the immediate importance of functionality but does not change the established V1 sourcing policy or prototype approach.
The source neither changes the system-layout deliverable nor requests a concrete CAD revision; aesthetic brainstorming is only proposed for a later discussion.
The premium visual-positioning decision does not modify the finalized wiring-plan deliverable.
